title: fracreg — Fractional Response Models
text: fracreg handles: Univariate Fractional Models (fracreg): Fit standard 1-part models, hurdle 2-part models (mass 0 1), double-inflated 3-part models. Panel Data Models (fracregpd): Estimate fractional models fixed-T longitudinal data, supporting Correlated Random Effects (CRE) handle unobserved individual heterogeneity. Endogeneity & Heteroscedasticity (fracreghet): Correct endogenous covariates using Instrumental Variables (IV) via Control Function GMM approaches. Diagnostic Testing: Includes generalized goodness--functional-form (fracreg.ggoff), RESET (fracreg.reset), non-nested P-tests (fracreg.ptest). Analytical Partial Effects: Compute exact marginal effects model types (including 3-part composite effects) via Delta method using fracreg.pe().

title: Fitting Fractional Response Models — fracreg
text: fracreg estimates one-part, two-part hurdle, three-part double-inflated fractional response models; see Ramalho, Ramalho Murteira (2011) Fang Ma (2013) details models. One-Part Fractional Response Models (type = "1P"): standard one-part model assumes conditional expectation fractional response \(y_i \[0,1]\) given : $$E(y_i|x_i) = G(x_i \beta)$$ \(G(\cdot)\) known non-linear link function mapping linear predictor unit interval (e.g., logit, probit). parameters \(\beta\) estimated maximising Bernoulli-based quasi-log-likelihood function: $$\ln L_i(\beta) = y_i \ln[G(x_i \beta)] + (1 - y_i) \ln[1 - G(x_i \beta)]$$ estimator requires correct specification conditional mean yield consistent parameter estimates (Papke Wooldridge, 1996). Two-Part Hurdle Models (type = "2P"): data exhibits boundary mass (e.g., \(y_i = 0\)), two-part hurdle model handles boundary values separately interior fractional values. Let \(y_i^*\) binary indicator \(y_i^* = 1\) \(y_i > 0\) \(y_i^* = 0\) otherwise. probability observing boundary value modelled : $$P(y_i = 0 | x_{1i}) = 1 - F(x_{1i} \gamma_1)$$ $$P(y_i > 0 | x_{1i}) = F(x_{1i} \gamma_1)$$ \(F(\cdot)\) binary link function. Conditional observing interior fractional value, response modelled : $$E(y_i | x_{2i}, y_i > 0) = G(x_{2i} \beta_2)$$ unconditional mean response therefore: $$E(y_i|x_i) = F(x_{1i} \gamma_1) \times G(x_{2i} \beta_2)$$ Three-Part Double Inflated Models (type = "3P"): data containing boundary mass \(0\) \(1\), three-part model estimates two separate binary mechanisms boundary fractional component interior values \((0, 1)\), extending two-part logic double inflation (Fang Ma, 2013). fracreg uses standard glm command perform estimations. Therefore, fracreg essentially convenience command, allowing estimation several alternative fractional response models using command. addition, fracreg provides R-squared measure models (calculated square correlation coefficient actual fitted values dependent variable), calculates fitted values dependent variable two-part models stores information needed implement useful commands fractional response models: fracreg.reset (RESET test), fracreg.ptest (P test), fracreg.ggoff (GGOFF tests) fracreg.pe (partial effects).

title: Fitting Panel Data Fractional Response Models — fracregpd
text: fracregpd computes GMM estimators proposed Ramalho, Ramalho Coelho (2018) panel data fractional response models time-variant time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity endogeneous covariates: GMMww, GMMc, GMMbgw, GMMpfe, GMMcre GMMpre. addition, fracregpd also computes QMLcre, proposed Papke Wooldridge (2008) Wooldridge (2019). Correlated Random Effects (CRE) - QMLcre: panel data, unobserved individual-specific heterogeneity \(c_i\) may correlated covariates \(x_{}\). CRE approach (Papke Wooldridge, 2008) models dependence projecting \(c_i\) onto time averages strictly exogenous covariates \(\bar{x}_i\): $$c_i = \psi + \bar{x}_i \xi + a_i$$ \(a_i\) error term independent \(x_i\). Assuming \(a_i | x_i \sim N(0, \sigma_a^2)\) probit link, integrating \(a_i\) yields "population-averaged" scaled conditional mean: $$E(y_{} | x_i) = G(x_{} \beta_a + \psi_a + \bar{x}_i \xi_a)$$ parameters subscript \(\) scaled \((1 + \sigma_a^2)^{-1/2}\). equation estimated via pooled Bernoulli QML. Generalized Method Moments (GMM): models strict exogeneity fails link function exponential-type link, Ramalho et al. (2018) propose GMM estimators based following general moment conditions: $$E[Z_{} (H(y_{}) - \exp(x_{}\beta + c_i))] = 0$$ \(H(\cdot)\) transformation function \(Z_{}\) matrix valid instruments. Estimators GMMww, GMMc, GMMbgw use different transformations eliminate unobserved fixed effect \(c_i\) applying GMM. overidentified models, fracregpd calculates Hansen's J statistic test validity overidentifying restrictions.
